target: fruit (PO_0009001)
reason: A count suffix like '-flowered' and '-seeded' in config/flora_counted_parts.tsv: 'fascicles 2-fruited' is the number of fruits per fascicle. Add 'fruited -> fruit' as a counted part (pattern 03). Exact.

target: capitulum inflorescence (PO_0030121) with male (PATO_0000384) as the state of the bearer (pattern 04); 'male' is already a reviewed context word for inflorescences
reason: head is a BROAD synonym of capitulum inflorescence (rule C262); a male head is a staminate capitulum, a kind expressed with the male quality. Staminate inflorescence PO_0025601 is broader and loses the head.

target: tertiary leaf vein (PO_0008021)
reason: PO lists cross-vein as a synonym of tertiary leaf vein. The transverse veins ('transversales') of Melastomataceae and grasses run between the main veins and arise from them. Narrower.

target: staminode (PO_0009077): 'into 3 lobes' is a count of lobes (pattern 03) or PATO lobed; lobe shape and fusion are read on the staminode
reason: A real structure, but only 2 floras and 10 statements use it. That is too little for a class beside stigma lobe and corona lobe, so a rule on staminode is preferred.

target: anthela inflorescence (PO_0030125)
reason: Anthelodium is the Juncaceae/Cyperaceae term for an anthela-like, cymose inflorescence. It is narrower than PO's anthela, which was defined on Filipendula. 'Secondary anthelodia' are partial inflorescences of it.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) as part of the base (FLOPO_0985024 plant organ base) of a non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075); 'juxtacostal' (beside the costa PO_0030072) cannot be expressed and is dropped
reason: Moss leaf cells. PO has no leaf lamina cell class for bryophytes, only alar cell PO_0030057. The region and the whole are expressible.

target: leaf scar (FLOPO_0986052)
reason: Hyphenated form of the existing FLOPO class. Exact.

target: disc gland (FLOPO_0986045)
reason: French 'glandes discales' are glands of the floral disc; the existing class covers them. Exact. Caveat: in some families flat disc-like glands on the leaf blade are also called discal; check the source flora.

target: perianth lobe (FLOPO_0986004)
reason: 'Fleurs à 4-5 lobes' are the lobes of the (often undifferentiated) perianth. Calyx lobe and corolla lobe are narrower and cannot be chosen without context. Broader target.
A generic swelling that needs the organ it belongs to, like 'protuberance' in the previous review. The quality reading is FLOPO gibbous.

target: portion of secretory tissue (PO_0005656)
reason: The translucent, yellow, red or black punctations (ponctuations) of Myrtaceae, Hypericaceae and Rutaceae leaves and petals are gland dots. Same target as the gland rule (C265); the surface reading is FLOPO gland-dotted. Narrower.

target: vascular bundle (PO_0005020)
reason: Costula/costulae is the vein of a fern pinnule or segment; the same as costule, rule C394. Narrower.

target: phyllome lamina lobe (PO_0025514) as part of pinna (FLOPO_0985027) (pattern 12)
reason: The lobes of a pinnatifid pinna. They are not pinnules, which are fully separate divisions. Unlike the generic 'segment' it names its whole.
A clustered calcium oxalate crystal inside a cell: a mineral inclusion (substance), not an anatomical part. PO has no crystal classes.

label: pollinarium
definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is the unit of pollen dispersal of an orchid or asclepiad flower (PO:0009046), made of two or more pollinia (FLOPO:0986016) and the structures that join them (caudicles FLOPO:0986033, a stipe, and a viscidium FLOPO:0986032 or corpusculum). NOTE: Propose to PO upstream with pollinium, caudicle and viscidium (orchid/Apocynaceae request, issue 6).
reason: A real structure with no class; pollinium alone covers only the pollen mass. The 'corpusculum' examples were grounded to the whole and should go to the corpusculum (the viscidium in Apocynaceae).
Plural of 'scale', which the previous review rejected as a generic part that needs its organ (trichome scale, bract or scale leaf).

target: pinnule (FLOPO_0985028)
reason: The first-order pinnules of a pinna. Narrower: the position in the series of divisions is dropped.
An order of division without its organ, like 'primary segment' and 'ultimate segment', which were rejected as generic.

target: plant spore (PO_0025017): the outer wall's ornamentation (reticulate, spinulose) is read as the spore's surface quality; 'sans exospore' is not read
reason: Exospore is the outer layer of the spore wall in ferns and lycophytes. PO models no spore or pollen wall layers; the qualities describe the spore surface.

target: stalk (PO_0025066)
reason: The orchid pollinarium stipe formed from the rostellum surface (tegula). It follows rule C264 (stipe -> stalk). Narrower; the pollinarium proposed above could later be its whole.

target: phyllome lamina (PO_0025396) as part of petal (PO_0009032) (pattern 12)
reason: The expanded blade of a clawed petal (as in Caryophyllaceae, 'limb bifid'). A petal is a phyllome, and PO has no petal lamina class.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) as part of the distal region of a non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075)
reason: Moss distal laminal cells; same treatment as basal juxtacostal laminal cells. 'Papillae branched' would be better read on papilla cell (PO_0025166).
'Costa ending 2-6 cells before apex' gives how far the costa stops short of the leaf tip, measured in cells. It is a fragment of a position statement on the costa (PO_0030072), not a part.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) as part of the distal region of a non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075); the wall qualities (thin, thickened, incrassate) are read on the cell
reason: The cell wall is not in PO; GO:0009505 plant-type cell wall exists but no FLOPO rule uses GO bearers. The qualities are a cell-level feature of moss leaves.

label: hair-point
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0025075 (non-vascular leaf)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a non-vascular leaf (PO:0025075) that is a hyaline, hair-like extension of its apex, formed by the excurrent costa or the lamina, as in Grimmia and Tortula. NOTE: No class in PO; awn PO:0025349 is restricted to grass glumes, lemmas and paleas. Propose to PO upstream (bryophyte anatomy).
reason: A standard character in moss floras and a real structure with no class.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) as part of the distal region of a non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075); thin/thickened/trigonous (trigones) read on the cell
reason: Same as distal cell wall: the cell wall has no PO class.
A fragment of a count phrase ('flowers ca. 3 visible per spiral'); the counted part is the flower, the spiral its series. Like the rejected 'per node' and 'per whorl'.

target: stamen (PO_0009029) as part of flower (PO_0009046) with female (PATO_0000383) (pattern 12)
reason: The sterile stamens of female flowers. The sex is a quality of the whole flower, which is exactly pattern 12; 'étamines stériles' could alternatively ground to staminode PO_0009077.

target: leaf lamina (PO_0020039) with the abaxial surface ('lower surface' context word, surface: abaxial)
reason: leaf blade is a synonym of leaf lamina; 'lower surface' is already a reviewed surface context word. Exact.
Crystals (calcium oxalate, alongside tannin) are cell contents (substances), not anatomical parts. PO has none.
